Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Nagendra Singh,Kuldeep,Praveen Saxena Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Section 528 Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS"), has been filed by the applicant to permit him to submit two sureties and one personal bond for all nine cases from the applicant and applicant has been granted bail in all cases by the court below.

sentences.text: 1 Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in all nine cases.

He next submitted that in all the cases registered against the applicant,
he has been granted bail by the court below.
He says that the applicant is very poor person and not in a position to furnish huge sureties in each and every case in compliance of bail orders.

It is further submitted that the details of cases registered against applicant in District Raibareli are as follows:-
( i ) C a s e C r i m e N o . 2 9 o f 2 0 2 2 , u n d e r S e c t i o n s 272/302/420/467/468/471/328/120-B/259/260 I.P.C. and 60-A/72 Excise Act and 63 Copy Right Act and Section 104 Trade Mark Act, Police Station Maharajganj (ii) Case Crime No. 36 of 2022, under Sections 420/467/468/471/272/304 I.P.C. and 60-A Excise Act, Police Station Mill Area (iii)Case Crime No. 37 of 2022, under Sections 420/467/468/471/272 I.P.C. and 60-A Excise Act, Police Station Mill Area (iv) Case Crime No. 152 of 2022, under Section 2/3 U.P. Gangster Act, Police Station Maharajganj (v) Case Crime No. 83 of 2022, under Section 2/3 U.P. Gangster Act, Police Station Bachhrawan (vi) Case Crime No. 218 of 2021, under Sections 272/273/419/420/467/468/471 I.P.C. and 60(1)/72 Excise Act and Section 103/104 Trade Mark Act, Police Station Bachhrawan (vii) Case Crime No. 263 of 2021, under Section 8/20 N.D.P.S. Act, Police Station Shivrantanganj (viii) Case Crime No. 37 of 2018, under Section 60 Excise Act, Police Station Shivgarh (ix) Case Crime No. 22 of 2018, under Section 60 Excise Act, Police Station Shivgarh Learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the judgment of the Apex Court passed in Special Leave to Appeal (Criminal) No. 8914-8915 of 2018; Hani Nishad @
Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs. State of U.P. Learned A.G.A. submits that he does not want to file any counter affidavit.

entities.text: Special Leave to Appeal (Criminal) No. 8914-8915 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text:
Hani Nishad @
Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs. State of U.P. Learned A.G.A.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the facts and circumstances as well as rival submissions advanced by the learned counsel for both the parties, the present application stands disposed of finally in the light law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky (Supra) and the Court below is directed to execute the personal bond of Rs. 20,000/- in every case and produce two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court/Magistrate concerned in one case which shall hold good for rest of the cases.
